name: Jacob Metoyer
headline: Undergraduate researcher at Cal State Long Beach. Computer science and physics, minor in biology.
summary: I work with research data in university labs, write research software, and run my own experiments on how well AI systems do real work.

Public repositories and dated snapshots document the work described here. Lab roles and education details drawn from my own account are marked self-reported; an institutional program page describes the program, not my membership.

projects.title: CaptureSuite
projects.summary: Windows-first multimodal research capture. A daemon owns the clock and session state, each device runs as a versioned worker plugin in C++ or Python, and a session is sealed into one package for quality checks and analysis. A simulator and a Lab Streaming Layer bridge let it run without vendor hardware.
projects.facts: Python and C++. GPL-3.0. Repository created 2026-09-03, last push 2026-09-29.

projects.title: CanvasPilot
projects.summary: A Canvas LMS command-line tool and MCP server for schools that disable API tokens: one login in a real browser, then a local session broker makes the REST calls. Fixture mode runs the tests offline.
projects.facts: Python. MIT. Repository created 2026-09-05, last push 2026-10-01.

projects.title: TowerOps
projects.summary: A synthetic air-traffic decision-support demo built for the AWS Agents for Humans challenge. An agent may propose an advisory; deterministic code checks conflict projection, state freshness, approval and readback before the simulated state changes, and writes a hash-chained audit log. Not operational ATC software and not connected to live aircraft.
projects.facts: Python, Strands Agents. MIT. Repository created 2026-09-14, last push 2026-09-15.

research.title: Gait rehabilitation research

research.role: Participant-session support, motion-capture marker labeling, trial organization and data quality checks. Repaired a gait-analysis workflow ported from MATLAB to Python: unit mismatches, gait event detection, and errors instead of wrong numbers.

research.title: Protein molecular dynamics
research.role: Located, cleaned and standardized molecular-dynamics trajectories; computed PCA and RMSF features; wrote physical-plausibility checks (RMSD, radius of gyration, bond geometry) for AI-generated protein structures; turned field literature into validation plans.
